messages:
alex_chang: FYI CI is flaky on infra PR #482 — Atlantis `apply` finishes but shortly after ArgoCD auto-sync rolls back the k8s resources TF just created. Apply shows success, then app gets out-of-sync and ArgoCD force-syncs old manifests. Anyone run into this race before?
priya: ugh, yeah. do you have logs from Atlantis and ArgoCD sync event?
alex_chang: pasted the relevant bits:```
Atlantis: Apply complete. Resources: namespace/my-team, configmap/team-config
ArgoCD: detected change, reconciled, restored manifest commit abc123 -> previous-def
```
alex_chang: Looks like ArgoCD is watching the same cluster and thinks TF-created resources are divergence to Git state.
jamie: Two common patterns: 1) stop making k8s objects from TF and instead let GitOps (ArgoCD) own them; 2) keep TF-managed resources but tell ArgoCD to ignore them or sequence syncs so apply finishes first.
luis: For sequencing, we added a tiny GH Actions job that waits for Atlantis to finish and then triggers an argocd sync for that app. Works when the change is meant to be live immediately.
priya: can you share the GH Action snippet? That sounds doable for targeted cases.
luis: sure — we use the argocd CLI + GH secret. Minimal pattern:```yaml
name: wait-and-sync-argocd
on: workflow_run
jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install argocd CLI
        run: curl -sSL -o /usr/local/bin/argocd https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/releases/latest/download/argocd-linux-amd64 && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/argocd
      - name: Login to ArgoCD
        env:
          ARGOCD_SERVER: ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_SERVER }}
          ARGOCD_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_TOKEN }}
        run: argocd login $ARGOCD_SERVER --token $ARGOCD_TOKEN --insecure
      - name: Wait for Atlantis apply to finish (approx)
        run: sleep 10s # can be replaced by real check
      - name: argocd app sync my-team-app --wait
        run: argocd app sync my-team-app --timeout 180s --wait
```
priya: where do you wire ARGOCD_TOKEN? github secrets? and do we need cluster credentials?
luis: ARGOCD_TOKEN stored in repo-level secrets (or org). The token is for the argocd API user; no kubeconfig in GH actions required since argocd server does the reconcile. We also keep a fallback: run `kubectl -n my-team rollout status` if the app exposes k8s resources that need extra waiting.
ajamie: small alternative: use ArgoCD's `app wait` from within Atlantis post-apply hook. Atlantis supports custom workflows so in `atlantis.yaml` you can add a `post_apply` step that calls argocd. Example:```yaml
projects:
- dir: infra/k8s
  workflow: default
workflows:
  default:
    plan:
      steps:
        - init
        - plan
    apply:
      steps:
        - apply
        - run: argocd app sync my-team-app --timeout 180s --wait
```
jamie: note: Atlantis runs in-cluster (or where it's deployed) so you need argocd CLI available to Atlantis container or use a small script that calls the ArgoCD HTTP API. Also ensure secrets for argocd token are mounted into Atlantis.
priya: can we also consider telling ArgoCD to ignore a subset of resources coming from TF? e.g., resource hooks or `argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: IgnoreExtraneous`?
luis: you can add `argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: IgnoreExtraneous` annotation on the app, but that may hide real drift. I'd rather sequence/sync explicitly for infra changes.
alex_chang: seems like the least surprise path is: keep TF create+apply; add post-apply sync step in Atlantis (or separate GH workflow) that triggers/waits for ArgoCD sync; store ARGOCD_TOKEN in `infra` repo secrets; update atlantis deployment to have that secret if using Atlantis post hook. I'll open a PR with the GH Actions version first (simpler) and we can iterate.
priya: SGTM. ping me on the PR for review. Also add a short comment in the PR describing the secret setup and the failure mode this prevents.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: New workflow PR created by alex_chang: [infra#534] wait-and-sync-argocd (link)
jamie: quick nit: set `timeout` to something sensible (5m) and add retries/backoff for argocd login. small scripts make this easier to test locally.
luis: i'll drop a helper script in `infra/scripts/argocd-sync.sh` that wraps login + sync + wait and handles transient errors.
alex_chang: thanks all — will open PR now and tag reviewers. If this still flakes after sequencing we'll consider moving ownership to GitOps entirely for these k8s resources. :thumbsup:
